title: Mixed Event — Never Give Up Cooking! — Episode2 A Special Gift

meta.Event Outline: Tsukasa and Saki invite Toya over for a party. With White Day approaching, he wants to give something back to the two of them. He tries his hand at baking from scratch, with varying results...

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (MEIKO said that it'd be okay for me and Akito to enter, but I'm still not sure if I should have...)
Okay, all that's left is to take this dough and let it cool in the fridge!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, and we need to be careful to not touch it too much. Otherwise, the butter may melt away.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay! Got it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (They seem to be making something in the kitchen together... But what...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's it!
Just wrap it in plastic and... Hm?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, Toya! Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?! T-Toya?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry for interrupting. I heard that you had this place to yourselves today... Shall I leave?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not to worry! Oh, but... If you don't mind waiting a second, we need to wrap this in some plastic first. So, Len, let's get to it...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Phew... Thank you for waiting, Toya. I apologize for us being a little all over the place.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
More importantly, that looked like...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: U-Uhh...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We were actually just making some cookies.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: K-KAITO, why'd you tell him?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha! Sorry, but I had a feeling that he'd find out regardless of whether or not we told him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to spoil your secret.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, no. That's totally fine!
It's actually okay if you know, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But please don't tell MEIKO, Rin or the others. We want to surprise them with these!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Surprise them...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's almost White Day, right?
So, we want to give them some gifts.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it wouldn't be much fun to give them something simple, so I thought I could make them their gifts. KAITO was just showing me how.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. Now I understand...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Truth be told, MEIKO is a much better baker than I am. However, they're meant for her, so we can't really ask her to help us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
I hope they turn out well, Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Me too! Oh, also...
Don't tell Kohane or An too! I wanna give them some too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, I promise not to tell them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Still, White Day...
I'll need to think of something soon.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you know who you're going to be giving back to, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, I plan on giving back to those important to me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Azusawa, Shiraishi, my mom...
MEIKO, Miku, Rin and Luka.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha! It sounds like you also have a lot of recipients in mind.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I think it's good that you wish to show so many different people how much you appreciate them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (People who I wish to show my appreciation for... Now that I think about it, that is a fairly long list...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Then, I'd like to give back to them as well...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We're even having our dinner party right around White Day, so it can also be my way of thanking them for inviting me.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Toya? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, no... Actually, some friends I've known since I was little invited me over to their house for a party.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I was just thinking that I could do something for them in return.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, you should come up with something really nice for them! After all, we're talking about White Day here!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something really nice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree with you.
I'll try giving this some more thought.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It really is wonderful, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me? Why, White Day, of course.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean, even if you wish to show others how much you appreciate them, opportunities to say how you actually feel don't come often, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, having an entire day dedicated to doing just that makes things much easier.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: For instance, Len here has trouble expressing how he truly feels, but is working very hard in preparation for White Day to make up for his shortcomings.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: H-Hey, don't phrase it like that!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, just outside the window... Isn't that Akito?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, yes...
It's almost time for us to meet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But... If we don't act quickly, Azusawa and Shiraishi will also end up coming here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Len, I'm going to explain what's going on to Akito and try to move our meeting location...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You will? Thanks, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not a problem. So, you two, good luck baking those cookies.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you! Have fun at practice, Toya!
A few days later
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
They really do have a large assortment of sweets and snacks available here.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I hope I'm able to find something that both Tsukasa and Saki will like...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This shop seems to primarily make baked sweets...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Madeleines, macarons, poundcakes and all sorts of other treats.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm not the biggest fan of sweets, but I have a feeling that Tsukasa and Saki will like something from here.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (They'll probably end up liking whatever I give to them...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (In that case...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, you should come up with something really nice for them! After all, we're talking about White Day here!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Something really nice... That's easier said than done.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What should I do...?
Ah, Aoyagi, hello there.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Fancy seeing you here.
Were you browsing gifts for White Day?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How did you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, you were staring at that display case full of sweets and sighing. It was easy to connect those two dots.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: More importantly, you seem somewhat concerned... Were you having that much trouble deciding what to buy?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was just...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Wait, Kamishiro works with Tsukasa at the same show stage...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He may be able to give me an insight into what Tsukasa likes...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Then...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, actually... Would you mind if I asked you for some advice?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I don't mind since I've already finished doing what I came here to do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much. Then...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
So you wish to give Tsukasa and Saki something very special.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and you spend quite a lot of time with Tsukasa. That's why I was hoping you could give me some advice regarding him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, well... I don't know Saki all that well, but I may be able to help you with Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At the same time, I feel that they'd like whatever you choose to give them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it seems like you won't be satisfied with just that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, um... I'd like to get them something really nice. Something they'd both genuinely enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... Then, why not make some sweets for them?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What? Make some for them...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I was actually fortunate enough to receive some homemade gifts for Valentine's Day from my fellow troupe members, and I sort of couldn't believe how happy I felt.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It was a strange sensation.
I tried thinking about why I felt that way...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I ultimately arrived on those gifts being imbued with their respective giver's thoughts and feelings.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Their thoughts and feelings...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. You could even tell that each gift they made was for a specific member of our troupe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course, there are countless ways to convey how you feel to others...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With one of them being making something for them. Which I'm sure they'll both enjoy very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
That is a wonderful idea.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But, I...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I did actually think about making something for them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I don't have much experience cooking or baking... I'm afraid that I'll disappoint them by making something that isn't very good. So, I've been shying away from that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I've begun to change my mind after hearing what you said, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to make something for them that comes from my heart...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, thank you for the advice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're welcome, and good luck.
I hope they like what you make for them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too!
